title: Restricted ADMINISTRATOR role + admin gate + expanded admin dashboard metrics (frontend)

requirements.summary: Add ADMINISTRATOR role option to profile setup UI and restrict selection to leader allowlist based on entered name/email or normalized phone.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile setup screen shows three role options: Parent, Child, ADMINISTRATOR.
ADMINISTRATOR can only be selected when the user has entered either one of the allowed emails in the Name field OR the allowed phone number in the phone field (normalized to the app’s phone format).
If the identifier is not allowlisted, the ADMINISTRATOR option is disabled and the UI explains that access is restricted to the leader account.

file_operations.description: Add a third role option labeled “ADMINISTRATOR” (mapped to AppRole.admin) in the role RadioGroup. Implement allowlist checks against the entered name (case-insensitive match for “tigguinrodrigues@gmail.com” and “tigguinclash@gmail.com”) and phone input normalized via existing phone utilities; disable the ADMINISTRATOR option when not allowlisted and render a clear “restricted to leader account” explanation. Ensure phone input is available/usable for allowlist matching even before selecting ADMINISTRATOR. Use the authorization component’s profile-setup/RBAC approach (via existing profile save flow). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add/adjust a helper usage pattern (no breaking changes) to ensure the admin allowlist phone comparison can reliably normalize “(91)980115950” to the same digits-only format used by the app, and to produce the backend-stored format when saving. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add/update translation strings for the ADMINISTRATOR role label and the restricted-access helper message shown when the option is disabled. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add/update Portuguese translation strings for the ADMINISTRATOR role label and the restricted-access helper message shown when the option is disabled. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add an in-session admin password gate UI that blocks AdminPanel until verified when backend recognizes the caller as admin.
acceptanceCriteria: When isCallerAdmin is true and the session gate is not passed, the app shows the AdminPasswordGate component instead of AdminPanel.
After entering the correct admin password, the session is marked as passed (using the existing sessionStorage gate), and the AdminPanel becomes visible.
Logging out clears the admin gate session (existing behavior remains).

file_operations.description: Wire the dedicated admin access step: when isCallerAdmin is true, render AdminPasswordGate until useAdminGate().isGatePassed is true; only then render AdminPanel. Keep non-admin routing unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the gate calls passGate() on successful password verification and provides clear error feedback on failure (existing behavior), and optionally hide/disable the password-change tab unless the backend indicates the caller is allowlisted admin (via a new query hook). This supports the restricted admin-password change rule while keeping backend enforcement authoritative. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a query hook to fetch whether the current admin is leader-allowlisted (wrap backend capability isCallerAllowlistedAdmin) for AdminPasswordGate UI decisions, and ensure existing isCallerAdmin remains used for gating. Use patterns consistent with the authorization component guidance. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Display expanded admin dashboard metrics and implement a lightweight presence heartbeat from the frontend to support an active-sessions estimate.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes an admin-only query (either extending getAggregatedMetrics or adding a new metrics query) that returns all requested counts.
“Total users who have ever logged in” is computed from stored user profiles (not from Internet Identity email, and not from external systems).
Frontend AdminPanel displays these metrics in the existing metrics cards section (AggregatedMetricsCards) or an equivalent admin metrics component.

The app implements a lightweight presence mechanism: the frontend periodically calls a backend method to record last-seen timestamps for the current principal; “users with platform open” is computed as users seen within a defined recent window (e.g., last 2–5 minutes) and is visible in the admin dashboard.

file_operations.description: Add a query hook to fetch admin dashboard metrics (wrap backend capability getAdminDashboardMetrics) and a mutation/helper to call recordHeartbeat. Configure reasonable refetching for the metrics on the admin screen (e.g., periodic refetch) without excessive polling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a small hook that, when authenticated (actor available), periodically calls the backend capability recordHeartbeat and also triggers on tab focus/visibility changes. Keep it best-effort and lightweight. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Start the presence heartbeat for authenticated users by wiring usePresenceHeartbeat into AppContent (or another always-mounted authenticated container) so active session estimates can work. Ensure it stops naturally on logout/identity clear. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Switch the admin dashboard metrics source to the admin metrics query (getAdminDashboardMetrics via a new hook) and pass the returned metrics into the metrics cards component. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Expand the metrics card UI to render: total Parents, total Children, total Parent→Child link count, total saved profiles (totalUsersEverLoggedIn), and activeSessionsEstimate. Update labels to use i18n and ensure bigint values are safely displayed as numbers/strings. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add i18n labels/descriptions for the new admin metrics (parents, children, links, total profiles, active sessions). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add i18n labels/descriptions for the new admin metrics (pais, filhos, vínculos, total de perfis, sessões ativas). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and display at least 3 additional admin metrics computed from on-chain state, rendered clearly without exposing individual child records.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 3 additional metrics are implemented and displayed, chosen from available state such as: number of disabled accounts, number of pending pairing requests, number of parents with zero children, number of children not paired to any parent, total count of activity entries across all children (aggregated only), total count of location entries across all children (aggregated only).
All additional metrics are available via an admin-only backend query and are rendered on the admin dashboard.
No admin UI exposes individual child activity/location records (only aggregated counts), preserving existing privacy behavior.

file_operations.description: Add at least 3 additional metric cards sourced from the admin metrics object (e.g., totalDisabledAccounts, totalPendingPairings, totalContentFiltersConfigured, totalSchedulesConfigured, totalAdmins). Ensure these are displayed as aggregated counts only (no per-child drilldown). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the expanded aggregated metrics section is displayed prominently on the admin dashboard and continues to show only aggregated values. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add i18n labels for the chosen additional metrics (e.g., disabled accounts, pending pairings, filters configured, schedules configured, total admins). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add i18n labels for the chosen additional metrics (e.g., contas desativadas, pareamentos pendentes, filtros configurados, agendas configuradas, total de admins). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
